mentions.name: jellyjoin
mentions.description: An open source Python package that performs high-quality "semantic soft joins": it matches records between datasets using embedding vectors and the Hungarian algorithm, aiming to be easier to use than traditional record linkage while still producing good matches.
mentions.problem: Record linkage is hard to use, and existing approaches don't balance ease of use with match quality for fuzzy/semantic joins.
mentions.source_excerpt: I found a neat way to do high-quality "semantic soft joins" using embedding vectors[1] and the Hungarian algorithm[2] and I'm turning it into an open source Python package
